label: Shade Striker's Ambush lets it retaliate: it deals its own printed 2 POWER to the attacker instead of the actual defender's 1 POWER
The actually-attacked Giant Tortoise still takes the attacker's own combat damage (its printed 1 POWER) regardless of who retaliates
The actually-attacked Giant Tortoise stays ready (Status 2): it did not retaliate, so it pays no retaliation cost
Shade Striker rests (Status 1) as the cost of retaliating via Ambush, even though it was never the attack's target
Shade Striker takes no combat damage itself: Ambush lets it retaliate without ever becoming the defender
